name: table-3d-responsive-ui-upgrade
title: Upgrade table 3D modal on desktop and mobile
description: Refine the existing manager table 3D simulator into a clearer desktop workspace and a reliable single-column mobile workflow without changing business behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Implemented the final responsive layout contract in the existing repair stylesheet. Desktop now uses an available-height viewer workspace and structured action area; mobile uses a full-screen single-scroll flow with catalog-first ordering, horizontal model cards, safe-area spacing, 44px touch targets, and non-overlapping static actions. Backend, GraphQL, permissions, audit logging, AR persistence and component callbacks were not changed. No CI workflow was triggered for the commit; local build/component tests and physical phone validation were not available through the GitHub connector.
